title: Ring-built mark into hero product drop
summary: A mark grows from a dot inside concentric pill-shaped hairlines, splits apart, and hard-cuts to a floating hero product under a frame-wide name that stretches off screen, then a white end card with a typed caption.
use_when: A physical product launch with one strong cutout photo or render
The brand mark has two halves or a symmetric shape that can split
A short 4:5 or 9:16 social teaser of about 6-7 s
E-commerce drops where the build-up matters more than features

look.type_style: extra-wide geometric display, rounded stroke ends, caps, product name ~7 % H spanning the full width; small lowercase grotesk wordmark ~3 % H; tiny caps mono caption ~0.7 % H

sfx.event: mark and rings grow from the dot
hard cut to the hero product
name strokes stretch off frame before the cut
caption words typed on the end card

structure.shot: white frame: a dot becomes a ring of hairlines, the two-part mark appears inside, rings stretch into a tall pill outline
structure.camera: push-in on the ring group: pill width 1.00 -> 1.30 from f23 to f60, speeding up over f57-f62
structure.motion: dot f1-f5, ring grows f6-f11 easings.outExpo; mark halves appear f12 and grow on springs.snappy (overshoot not measurable) by f18; rings elongate to a pill f18-f24 easings.outQuint; f60-f62 halves slide apart and their bars extend to both frame edges, easings.inExpo 3 fr

structure.shot: hero product cutout floating over a dark red landscape, pill hairlines behind, frame-wide product name, small wordmark and caption, corner dots
structure.camera: push-in on the photo 1.00 -> ~1.05 over the row (±0.25 s); type layer moves separately
structure.motion: name grows outward from two letter halves f63-f69 easings.outExpo 6 fr; the name then widens horizontally 1.00 -> ~1.40 across f69-f126 easings.linear; f126-f135 outer strokes stretch to and past the frame edges easings.inExpo 10 fr

structure.shot: white end card: mark left, small caps caption centre, wordmark right, pill hairlines zooming past the frame, edge dots
structure.camera: push-in on the hairlines 1.00 -> >1.6 (they leave the frame) f136-f173 easings.outExpo; static hold f173-f199
structure.motion: mark and wordmark present from f136; caption typed word by word, 7 words, one every 3-5 fr from f136 to f159; edge dots appear ~f150; hold 26 fr

params.brand: any brand.json: mark (ideally two symmetric halves), wordmark, fg/bg for the white frames, accent for the dark product backdrop
params.content.name: product name, 3-5 characters, set in a wide display face; it fills the frame width
params.content.caption: small caps line, 5-8 words, typed on the end card
params.content.productImage: cutout photo or render of the product (transparent PNG), placed over the backdrop
params.content.backdrop: full-bleed environment photo or a gradient in the accent colour

notes: Measured from 30 fps strips: cuts at f63 and f136; the hook build is front-loaded (dot to pill in 24 fr) then a slow push until a 3 fr split right before the cut. Both exits accelerate into the cut (split bars, stretched name strokes): the cut lands on the most extended frame. End card caption: 7 words over 23 fr. Silent reference: sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): ring-pill hairlines motif, stretch-type exit, edge registration dots.
